title: メカトロニクス
subtitle: Mechatronics
educationalGoal: Understand mechatronics, a multidisciplinary field of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and computer engineering. Learn sensor technology, principles of motors, and electrical and electronic circuits for sensors and motors.
advice: Course Content 1.Sensor Selection and Circuit Design Students will learn how to interpret data sheets for various sensors and develop a deeper understanding of sensor circuits that interface with microcontrollers. 2.DC Servo Motors and Control Circuits The course will cover the characteristics and selection methods of DC servo motors, which serve as representative actuators in robotic systems, along with an in-depth study of motor control circuits. 3.Mechanical Transmission and Motor Selection Students will learn how to mathematically model mechanical transmission mechanisms and apply these models to select appropriate DC motors for specific applications.
books: Textbooks: handout, Fundamentals of Mechatronics, Morikita Syuppan (in Japanese) Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of electronic circuits, control engineering, and computer engineering.

activityGoals.body: Be able to select sensors that meet the specified requirements.
Be able to select DC servo motors that meet the specified requirements.
Be able to design interface circuits and wiring diagrams to connect sensors and DC servo motors with microcontro
Be able to conceptualize mechatronic devices based on given specifications.
